RECREATIONAL.gov_quote: Adults 21 or older may purchase, possess, grow, or use non-medical cannabis.
RECREATIONAL.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://com.ohio.gov/divisions-and-programs/cannabis-control/licensee-resources/what-we-do/Ohio-Cannabis-FAQ.
RECREATIONAL.question: Is it legal for adults to possess cannabis in the state of Ohio?
RECREATIONAL.gov_section: An individual must be at least 21 years old to purchase, possess, grow, or use non-medical cannabis.

RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_quote: On November 7, 2023, a majority of Ohio voters approved Issue 2 to legalize the possession and use of cannabis by individuals aged 21 and over, and the sale of cannabis by state-licensed dispensaries, thus creating the Division of Cannabis Control (DCC or Division) within the Ohio Department of Commerce.

RECREATIONAL_STORE.question: Is it legal for adults to buy cannabis in a store in the state of Ohio?
RECREATIONAL_STORE.gov_section: On November 7, 2023, a majority of Ohio voters approved Issue 2 to legalize the possession and use of cannabis by individuals aged 21 and over, and the sale of cannabis by state-licensed dispensaries, thus creating the Division of Cannabis Control (DCC or Division) within the Ohio Department of Commerce.

RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_quote: Adults 21 or older may grow, store, and use their own cannabis at home, with a maximum of six plants per person and twelve per household.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.validation_notes: Live audit on 2026-09-08 found gov_section verbatim on https://com.ohio.gov/divisions-and-programs/cannabis-control/licensee-resources/what-we-do/Ohio-Cannabis-FAQ.
RECREATIONAL_GROW.question: Is it legal for adults to grow cannabis in the state of Ohio?
RECREATIONAL_GROW.gov_section: Section 3796.04 of the Ohio Revised Code permits adults aged 21 and over to grow, store, and use their own cannabis at home

sourceNotes: This pass started from https://com.ohio.gov/divisions-and-programs/cannabis-control/ on 2026-09-08 and stayed on com.ohio.gov. Prior citations for adult possession, home grow, medical possession, and medical grow were on codes.ohio.gov, and the medical store citation was on medicalmarijuana.ohio.gov. The Division FAQ at licensee-resources/what-we-do/Ohio-Cannabis-FAQ answers adult possession at 21, licensed sales that began August 6, 2024, home grow of up to six plants, and the ban on consuming adult-use or homegrown marijuana in a public place. Patient purchase is stated on the Find a Dispensary page. The 90-day patient possession limit is on Medical Marijuana Products and Daily Limits.
